text:
Isha: Found a suspiciously heavy paper bag in the supply closet labeled 'DO NOT OPEN UNTIL FRIDAY'. Anyone claim it?
Connor: that’s definitely the Office Piñata. Legend says it appears when slack reactions reach 1000.
Talia: wait we have a piñata? when did this happen?
Marco: it appeared during the Q4 migration. I hid it behind a stack of empty ergonomic mouse boxes.
Isha: can we have a gentle unwrapping ritual instead of blindfold whacking? open to compromise.
jamie-design: I'll design ceremonial masks. minimalist vibes.
Connor: rules proposal: 1) Must be opened only during snack hour. 2) Winner gets the first chocolate. 3) If healthy snacks fall out, double the coins.
Elena: double the coins meaning extra brag token? I'm in.
ops-bot: poll created: "How should we open the Piñata of Provisions?" 3 options: Gentle Unwrap; Blindfold Whack; Puzzle Solve. React with :one: :two: :three: to vote.
Marco: Puzzle solve sounds very Redwood. Solve a captcha and you get a candy.
Talia: also, can we establish piñata custody? rotate every month. Whoever holds it must label it and feed it with compliments.
Isha: compliments feeding is a soft power play but fine.
hr-bot: reminder: make sure activities are safe and inclusive. No swinging near monitors pls.
Jamie-design: first mask sketches incoming. Also thinking a tiny banner that says 'Sir Snacklot' for the piñata.
Connor: Sir Snacklot is perfect. Also nominate @Marco as first Keeper of Sir Snacklot.
Marco: honored. I'll set up a calendar event: 'Piñata Opening & Snack Redistribution' Friday 15:30 in kitchen.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Piñata Opening' Friday 15:30 in #random.
Talia: I'll bring a battery-powered confetti launcher (small and safe).
Isha: I'll bake cupcakes in tribute.
Elena: documenting for posterity: photo op required. We'll add to the office lore board.
Marco: agree. Also, new rule: if someone steals a cupcake, they must perform a short poem.
Connor: prepare your haikus.
Isha: now I'm nervous and excited. See you Friday. Long live Sir Snacklot.
